debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0–9); 1 shows buffer sizes, 2 adds URLs.

batch_mode.description: If true, exit immediately on error instead of entering interactive mode.

enable_js.description: Enable or disable JavaScript evaluation in HTML content.

network_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for network operations before timing out.

page_width.description: Maximum line width in characters for rendered HTML pages.

homepage.description: URL or file path to load automatically if no arguments provided.

startup_script.description: Path to a file containing edbrowse commands to execute at startup.

user_stylesheet.description: Path to a CSS file for custom rendering of HTML content.

charset.description: Default character encoding for text/HTML rendering.

cookies_enabled.description: Enable or disable cookie handling during HTTP requests.

cookies_file.description: File path to store persistent cookies.
